object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Open a Document Editor. Expected: it is in read-only mode, the Read-only action is checked, the read-only banner shows, and the grid's description cells aren't editable. Uncheck the Read-only action. Expected: read-only mode is off, the banner is hidden and the description cells are editable. Check it again. Expected: read-only mode is on and the banner shows.
